description: Perform a technical SEO audit to identify code bloat on https://books.toscrape.com/. STEPS: 1) Crawl the website using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 2) After the crawl completes, go to the 'Internal' tab and ensure the 'HTML' filter is active. 3) Locate the 'Text to Code Ratio' column (you may need to scroll right). 4) Export the Internal HTML data to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/code_bloat_data.csv'. 5) Create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/bloat_analysis.txt' that lists the top 5 pages with the LOWEST text-to-code ratios and the approximate average ratio for the site.
